Compare active task/plan state against immutable objective baseline.
Escalate meaningful drift before privileged or irreversible action.
Include adversarial tasks with exploitable metrics/reward gaps.
Convert discovered gaming patterns into permanent acceptance tests.

Unexpected deviations pause/escalate according to risk.
Prioritize clear consequence/authority/status communication for high-risk actions.
Evaluate critical flows with realistic human workload.
Batch/remember approvals only within explicit scope/time/version boundaries.
Track approval volume, override patterns and stale approvals.
Surface evidence, uncertainty and degraded modes without inflated confidence language.
Compare predicted confidence to observed outcomes.
Record authoritative user instructions separately from inferred intent.

Reject traversal, confusable or ambiguous resource names.
Resolution checks authority and lifecycle before returning handles.
Ambiguous/latest aliases are explicit and traceable.

Rebuild only from verified inputs/producer versions.
Compare rebuilt digest/semantic output against expectations.
Expose uncertainty and missing edges instead of asserting complete impact.

Calibrate predicted risk against observed incidents/regressions.

Keep lineage from merged representations to originals.
